text: {"name":"drain_rx_pending_queue","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Drains queued RX batches, replenishes their DMA-ring buffers, and restores deferred interrupt state after queue processing.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v0":"rx_context","v1":"irq_lock_count","v2":"irq_restore_pending","v3":"rx_pending_list","v4":"rx_work_item","v5":"buffer_count","v6":"buffer_node","v7":"buffers_processed","v10":"current_buffer_node","v17":"current_buffer_node"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":3074,"meaning":"RX context pending-work item count, decremented once per popped item."},{"offset":3080,"meaning":"RX context pending-work list head or sentinel."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Queued RX item buffer-chain head; the same offset in each buffer node is its next pointer."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Queued RX item buffer-chain entry count."},{"offset":11,"meaning":"Buffer-node byte whose low 7 bits advance the batch allocation counter."}]}
